nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How is risk management being adopted in strategic business management?
nodes.answer: Risk management is being adopted in strategic business management, especially in cases of scarce resources and critical supply chains.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Supply chain risk management_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How did the implementation of critical path management in SPD help reduce supply chain risks?
nodes.answer: The implementation of critical path management in SPD helped reduce supply chain risks through short lead-times for sourcing raw materials, consistent with Van Borscht et al. (2018).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Supply chain risk management_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Why is supply chain information often risky for brands according to the Journal of Cleaner Production?
nodes.answer: Supply chain information is often risky for brands due to supplier noncompliance, reputation-associated risks, and difficulties in setting up monitoring systems across fragmented and complex supply chains.
